title: SpatialBrain: Spatial Intelligence Growing from Experience
abstract: arXiv:2610.29317v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Spatial reasoning requires more than access to geometric tools: a reasoner must decide when direct observation is sufficient and when to reconstruct, measure, or change reference frames. We present SpatialBrain, a framework that retains experience about these decisions while keeping its vision-language backbone fixed. The key distinction is between evidence about a scene and experience about how to reason with that evidence. 3DFusionMemory fuses current-scene observations into queryable spatial relations. A Spatial Skill Library provides reusable tool procedures, and Spatial Cognition associates task conditions with experience about when and how to use memory and skills. Completed trajectories are abstracted into process records and consolidated between task blocks, allowing later decisions to draw on earlier execution without transferring scene coordinates or reference answers. translated_title: SpatialBrain：从经验中成长的空间智能
translated_abstract: 空间推理不仅仅依赖于获取几何工具：推理者必须判断何时直接观察就足够，何时需要重构、测量或改变参考系。我们提出了SpatialBrain，这是一个能够在保持视觉-语言骨干模型冻结不变的情况下，保留关于上述决策经验的框架。其核心区分在于：场景的证据（evidence）与如何利用这些证据进行推理的经验（experience）是不同的。3DFusionMemory将当前场景的观察融合为可查询的空间关系；空间技能库提供可复用的工具操作流程；空间认知模块将任务条件与何时以及如何使用记忆和技能的经验关联起来。完成的任务轨迹被抽象为过程记录，并在任务块之间进行整合巩固，使后续决策能够借鉴先前的执行经验，而无需传递场景坐标或参考答案。在五个空间推理基准测试中，SpatialBrain实现了性能提升……
tldr: SpatialBrain在冻结视觉-语言骨干模型的前提下，通过积累并复用“如何推理”的经验性知识（而非单纯依赖几何工具），在多个空间推理基准上显著提升了空间智能表现。
